summary.headline: Choice Health locks in $276K and identifies another $258K, totaling $534K in annual savings across five spend categories
summary.narrative: Through a focused strategic-sourcing program, Treya Partners delivered a finalized $276K annual reduction on Medical Supplies and surfaced an additional $258K across Fleet, Office Supplies and two temporary labor categories that are now moving through final negotiation and contracting. RFPs, supplier negotiations and contract execution were completed in under six months, giving Choice Health clear line-of-sight to more than half-a-million dollars in recurring savings.
